name: Sarah McBride
bio: a Representative from Delaware; born in Wilmington, New Castle County, Del., August 9, 1990; graduated from Cab Calloway School of the Arts, Wilmington, Del., 2009; B.A., American University, Washington, D.C., 2013; author; public advocate; member of the Delaware state senate, 2020-2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
